name: hyperbrowser_scrape
description: Scrape a single web page from a cloud browser and return clean content (markdown, html, links, and page metadata). Handles JS-rendered pages. Example: hyperbrowser_scrape({ url: "https://example.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

url.description: The full URL to scrape, e.g. "https://example.com/page"

onlyMainContent.description: If true, strip nav/footer/ads and return only the main article content. Default true.

formats.description: Output formats to include. Any of "markdown", "html", "links". Default ["markdown"].

_apiKey.description: Hyperbrowser API key. Sign up at https://app.hyperbrowser.ai (docs: https://docs.hyperbrowser.ai/).

name: hyperbrowser_extract
description: Extract structured JSON data from one or more web pages using an LLM. Provide a JSON schema and/or a natural-language prompt describing what to pull. Example: hyperbrowser_extract({ urls: ["https://example.com"], prompt: "Get the product name and price", schema: { type: "object", properties: { name: { type: "string" }, price: { type: "string" } } }, _apiKey: "your-key" })

urls.description: One or more URLs to extract data from.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the data to extract (used with or instead of schema).

schema.description: JSON Schema object describing the shape of the data to extract, e.g. { type: "object", properties: { title: { type: "string" } } }.

_apiKey.description: Hyperbrowser API key. Sign up at https://app.hyperbrowser.ai (docs: https://docs.hyperbrowser.ai/).

name: hyperbrowser_crawl
description: Crawl a website starting from a URL, following links and scraping each page to markdown. Use maxPages to bound the crawl. Example: hyperbrowser_crawl({ url: "https://example.com", maxPages: 10, _apiKey: "your-key" })

url.description: The starting URL to crawl, e.g. "https://example.com".

maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl. Default 10.

followLinks.description: Whether to follow links found on crawled pages. Default true.

_apiKey.description: Hyperbrowser API key. Sign up at https://app.hyperbrowser.ai (docs: https://docs.hyperbrowser.ai/).
